visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long reddish-brown hair stands at an airport entrance wearing a black sweatshirt with a 'BON APPETIT' bear graphic and a small brown shoulder bag. She leans over her luggage, checking her bag. (2) She sits in a brightly lit indoor lounge with plush yellow chairs, holding a white cup. She opens her brown bag, pulls out a green passport with 'Taiwan' written on it, and nods slightly. (3) The scene shifts to her walking through a terminal wearing a white face mask and dragging a black suitcase with a duffel bag on top. She repeatedly checks her shoulder bag and shows her passport to the camera. (4) She is shown napping on red terminal seats with her head tilted back. She suddenly wakes up, checks her bag for the passport, and looks relieved. (5) She walks alongside a large window with a clear view of an airplane on the tarmac, opening her bag yet again. (6) A close-up shows a hand holding the passport, followed by a shot of the woman looking distressed as a text overlay appears.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A relaxed lo-fi beat with a steady kick drum and soft synth pads begins. A male narrator states calmly, 'Making sure I have my passport in my bag.' (2) The BGM continues smoothly. The narrator repeats the exact same phrase with the same neutral inflection as the visual shows the lounge setting. (3) The beat persists. The narrator repeats the phrase again. Subdued airport terminal hum is audible in the background mix. (4) The lo-fi BGM continues. The narrator repeats the phrase. A brief, soft whoosh sound effect transitions the scene. (5) Same BGM and vocal loop continue as the narrator confirms the action of checking the bag. (6) The BGM continues briefly then fades slightly as the voice track ends, emphasizing the final punchline text.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously illustrate the obsessive habit of checking for a passport during travel, only to subvert the expectation with a final ironic twist of actually losing it.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a repetitive audio loop to build a sense of rhythm and expectation, which is effective for short-form comedic content.
